card: ALIAS: Aghnar — name given by the silver-haired healer in the laboratory
ROLE: Ape-like creature inhabiting the heights above the mushroom-dome settlement; associated with the Magon apes of that world
TRAIT: Rational and capable of speech, though this was not apparent before healing — speech after recovery revealed an intelligence that had not been visible
TRAIT: Asks why it was given life — first words spoken after healing with synthesized green blood
TRAIT: Describes its own physical makeup openly: throat, glands, body, and why ground-bound life is unsuitable for it
TRAIT: Warns that ascending above the mushroom domes is dangerous, then agrees to guide the way when pressed
TRAIT: Leapt away from the laboratory immediately after being named, returning to the heights

RELATIONSHIP: aghnar__warrior (Aghnar): Rescued after being struck by an epyphite dart and falling from the mushroom heights; healed with synthesized green blood in a laboratory; given the name 'Aghnar'
RELATIONSHIP: kiowotai (Kiowotai): Calls 'brother'; leads into the dangerous upper territory above the domes when pressed
VOICE: Speaks directly; asks existential questions on first breath, describes physical nature, names hunger, warns of danger

BOUNDARY: No known biography beyond the epyphite-dart wounding, rescue, healing with synthesized green blood, naming by the Metabaron, departure to the heights, hunger, brother-bond with Kiowotai, and guided ascent above the mushroom domes
BOUNDARY: This peer is the ape creature given the name 'Aghnar' by the Metabaron — not the Metabaron Aghnar nor any phase of the Metabaronic warrior lineage bearing that name

manual_review_notes: Source is thin but sufficient; this draft is format-valid, bounded, and keeps the ape companion distinct from the Metabaron Aghnar phase peers.
